properties.description: Erigo Apparel is a prominent Indonesian fashion brand that has established a significant presence by providing accessible, high-quality, and trendy casual clothing. Primarily targeting the youth demographic, the brand emphasizes a modern street-style aesthetic that allows for easy, daily expression. Through its accessible pricing and dynamic brand voice, it has become a staple for young consumers seeking to combine style with comfort. The brand continues to grow its reach by balancing global fashion trends with local preferences, maintaining a strong position in the Indonesian fashion retail market.
properties.audience_identity: Young individuals who value affordable, contemporary street-inspired fashion that allows them to express their personal identity and social presence.

The brand emphasizes local production and maintains a strong community-focused identity through its diverse product lines and sub-labels. It continues to expand its reach beyond footwear, incorporating grooming products into its lifestyle offerings to support a complete, active identity.

properties.description: Emoda is a prominent Japanese fashion brand recognized for its progressive and edgy approach to women's apparel. The brand specializes in high-impact, trend-driven pieces including signature denim, knitwear, and modern footwear designed for the urban consumer. With a focus on bold silhouettes and contemporary style, it caters primarily to young women who value self-expression and keeping pace with seasonal trends. Established in 2009, the brand maintains a strong presence in Japan's competitive fashion landscape through its direct-to-consumer digital channels and retail network.
properties.audience_identity: Individuals who gravitate toward a bold, trend-driven aesthetic and prioritize standing out with contemporary, edgy urban looks.

It operates primarily as a direct-to-consumer brand, maintaining a strong presence in its home market while expanding its footprint globally through strategic retail and e-commerce partnerships.

properties.description: Originating in New York City and expanding to Paris, this brand has become a global authority on the 'oversized' aesthetic, focusing on sharp, structured tailoring and modern silhouettes. The label balances high-fashion sensibilities with everyday wearability, offering a curated mix of essential pieces that define a sophisticated, relaxed wardrobe. With a strong digital presence and a cult following among fashion professionals, the brand is recognized for its ability to predict and set trends while maintaining a minimalist design language. Its offerings range from iconic blazer and trouser sets to elevated basics, catering to an audience that values timeless design with a contemporary, bold edge.
properties.audience_identity: Individuals who value a blend of masculine-leaning tailoring and effortless, contemporary silhouettes that project an air of sophisticated urban ease.

properties.description: Done Right & Co is a prominent jewelry brand led by Jimmy The Gent, known for delivering high-end, custom-crafted diamond pieces that signify status and success. The brand has built a cult following within the hip-hop and streetwear communities by focusing on intricate, iced-out designs tailored to individual aspirations. It maintains a strong market position as a premier provider of custom jewelry for entertainers, athletes, and ambitious entrepreneurs. The brand identity is deeply rooted in the philosophy of hustle, reflecting the drive of its clientele.
